title: Justification wording per hop: plain, Eva, Italian and English
goal: Each reason code has a short sentence in both voices and both languages
acceptance: Test first: every reason code has all four sentences and none is empty; examples "cloud: enabled for this role", "Haiku 5.5: cheapest model that passed this pilot's tests", "local: cloud budget used up", "Casper: always local" with Italian and Eva equivalents
Wording follows the voice rules in docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
